filter: services.discovery_sources.select_live_postings: preferred country IL, Israel city text including Hebrew names, backend/software titles, exclude intern/junior/frontend/mobile/qa/director/vp/devops/sre, at least one profile skill from languages_and_frameworks, data_and_streaming, or architecture_and_practices, publication date within 30 days when the source provides one. Update timestamps are not publication dates.

accepted.why: Dominant Israeli tech ATS. Public board HTML exposes a careers token. Live positions include country IL and description text. A Claroty/Coralogix/Plus500 sample selected 10 profile matches, including backend roles in Tel Aviv, Ramat Gan, and Haifa. No first-publication field: time_updated is only an edit clock, and edits older than 60 days are skipped. Catalog is the active comeetId values from github.com/mluggy/techmap companies. On 2026-10-19 streamsecurity/39.008 was added from a careers URL that had no comeetId. select_live_postings kept Software Engineer (Modeling) in Ramat Gan, edited 2026-10-18, matching Python. https://www.comeet.com/jobs/streamsecurity/39.008/software-engineer-modeling/54.E6A
